note: 0.4.585: the owner asked for the boy in the cell to be improved ("improve the texture of the boy before he transforms, too"). He was one row of the shared painter: a buttoned shirt, trousers and shoes, and a grown man's face. He is painted by his own tool, tools/draw_caged_boy.py, from what he becomes: the Minotaur's eyes in its tones, its dark hair, a grown person's shirt in its rag's cloth tied with its rope, trousers worn off below the knee, bare feet; nothing on him says what he is, and he has no wound. This painting supersedes only his own 0.4.100 sheet.
